How to be calm and clear-minded?
</message>
output: It makes me realize how much I crave that stillness, like a quiet room where my thoughts can finally settle instead of racing around in circles. I fear that if I don’t find it, I’ll keep spiraling into the same anxious loops, never truly seeing what’s right in front of me. At the same time, I want to learn how to let go of the noise and just be present, even if it feels like a small, fragile hope.
